summary_md: **EstimandLab ([@EstimandLab](https://x.com/EstimandLab/status/2115586912102609357))** summarizes **Nonstandard Errors in AI Agents**: 150 AI coding agents given the same six hypotheses and NYSE data reached widely varying answers, partly by choosing different measures, and written AI peer review barely narrowed the spread.
relevance: Variance in agent reasoning on identical research tasks: a caution for agent-driven analysis.
